title: Claude Routines Replaced My n8n and Zapier for Free
description:
Claude Routines: Automate Anything with Claude Code in Plain English

Claude Routines run scheduled automations in Anthropic's cloud, no nodes, no n8n, no Zapier. In this video I build a daily digest routine that pulls Vercel analytics, Supabase signups, and Stripe revenue for my app TiltIt and drops a summary in my Gmail every morning at 9 AM. Then I go one step further and build the whole routine from the terminal using Claude Code and the /schedule skill.

Comment "ROUTINE" and I'll DM you the full checklist with my exact routine prompts, connector setup, and scheduling steps.
